label: SurvNG incident notifications
info: Receives SurvNG object-incident lifecycle messages, publishes snapshots to Home Assistant MQTT Image entities, and updates one Companion notification per incident without a shared media mount. Plain motion incidents are ignored.

name: SETUP: MQTT credentials, HA server, and notify action
info:
1. Open the SurvNG MQTT broker node and add the same credentials used by SurvNG.
2. Open the final Home Assistant Action node and select your existing HA server.
3. In the Prepare HA notification function, replace notify.mobile_app_CHANGE_ME or set SURVNG_NOTIFY_ACTION in Node-RED.
4. No Home Assistant media mount is required. Snapshots are retained as per-camera MQTT Image entities and served through Home Assistant's authenticated image proxy.
5. Override SURVNG_INTERNAL_URL if SurvNG is not reachable at http://192.168.86.243:8088.
6. Optional environment overrides: SURVNG_MQTT_PREFIX (default survng) and HA_MQTT_DISCOVERY_PREFIX (default homeassistant).
